title: Agent Spend-Control Feature Matrix
description: Deterministic feature comparison of agent spend-control mechanisms across the platform layer (Locus agent connections, Ramp user-delegation and standalone agents) and the protocol layer (AP2 mandates, x402, Visa VIC token scope, Mastercard agentic tokens): identity model, budget granularity, attenuation rule, expiry, revocation path, audit attribution, receipt artifact. Every cell cites a dated, pinned source snapshot; unknown facts are marked not published, never inferred.

layers.description: Subset of layer ids to include (locus, ramp_ud, ramp_sa, ap2, x402, visa, mc).
